title: Industry Pulse — AI / Agent Ecosystem

bullets.title: Anthropic expands Claude Cowork to mobile and web — cross-device sync, background/scheduled execution, phone approvals
bullets.summary: Announced Jul 7: sessions sync across devices, tasks run in the background with no device online, work can be scheduled for a set time, and Claude surfaces human-judgment decisions to your phone; beta starts on Max, doubled usage limits extended through Aug 5.
bullets.how: This is the exact background/scheduled/long-running autonomy The Construct built by hand; the platform now ships sync and phone approvals natively — re-evaluate what's still worth owning vs. handing to the platform, and lean on scheduled/background execution for our daily scans.

bullets.title: The 2026-07-28 MCP Specification Release Candidate is out — biggest protocol revision since launch
bullets.summary: Stateless core that scales on ordinary HTTP, an MCP Apps extension for server-rendered UIs, a Tasks extension for long-running work, and OAuth/OIDC-aligned authorization; final ships Jul 28.
bullets.how: The Tasks extension standardizes our multi-hour/multi-day agent pattern; stateless HTTP + OIDC simplify hosting and securing our own servers — plan the RC→final migration as scheduled maintenance ahead of Jul 28.

bullets.title: Anthropic donates MCP to the neutral Agentic AI Foundation (AAIF) under the Linux Foundation
bullets.summary: MCP becomes vendor-neutral alongside Block's goose and OpenAI's AGENTS.md; backers AWS, Anthropic, Block, Bloomberg, Cloudflare, Google, Microsoft, OpenAI; 10,000+ public MCP servers live.
bullets.how: Governs The Construct's entire MCP fleet; neutral stewardship de-risks our all-in MCP bet and pairs with the Jul 28 spec RC — treat protocol evolution as planned standards-body maintenance.

bullets.title: Google delays Gemini 3.5 Pro to July 17 for a full architectural rebuild — 2M context, 'Deep Think' layer
bullets.summary: Google scrapped the 2.5 Pro architecture and rebuilt for math reasoning, SVG/image quality and autonomous workflows to compete with GPT-5.6 and Fable 5.
bullets.how: A live build-vs-buy and model-routing option for reasoning- and coding-heavy Construct work; benchmark against Sonnet 5 once it ships, and note the 2M context for long-document jobs.

bullets.title: Capital keeps flooding the long-running-agent infra layer — Sail Research $80M ($450M val), Baseten $1.5B Series F
bullets.summary: Investors funding the durable-autonomy substrate for agents that run hours-to-days ('run models, not build them').
bullets.how: The multi-hour/multi-day autonomy layer our harness depends on; cheaper long-run inference directly enables our Fable/Opus long-autonomy tiers — track as a cost lever for scheduled scans and agent loops.

praxis_lesson: Today the platform shipped the autonomy we hand-built — Cowork's background/scheduled execution and cross-device approvals, plus the MCP Tasks extension for long-running work, are now first-class product features, not Construct differentiators. The durable moat moves up another layer: orchestration logic, verification loops, memory tiers, and the domain-specific judgment in our scheduled scans. Let the platform own the plumbing (sync, scheduling, protocol, auth) and concentrate our build where no vendor commoditizes it for us.
